result.detail: There is exactly one equivalence_setup file. It sits at the top level so that its relative reads of gray_counter.v and gray_counter_refactor.v resolve to the approved sources the platform places beside it. No file uses those source names. The [gold] and [gate] scripts differ in the file they read, so the gate's identical-script check does not apply. No engine line is given, so the sby strategy's default engine is used. Equivalence shows only that the two versions agree with each other. It does not show that either one matches the specification.
